author: source_methods

scope.test_fixture_role: Existing hand-authored contract fixtures; not benchmark-arm or independently generated model outputs.

changes.finding: mandatory input capability can be placed only on an unreachable screen while a reachable goal target still contains the needed information
changes.fix: For each mandatory input feature, resolve its canonical feature and require an accessible placement for each original input role. Compute the union of reachability from every entry that permits that role.
changes.scope_limit: The canonical capability need not live on the goal route's selected target. An alternate authorized entry and separate role-specific placements remain valid.

changes.finding: The old checker and one test accepted multi-hop merges despite A02 requiring a direct reference to a kept canonical feature
changes.fix: Validate that each merge.target directly names a keep feature; retain the existing resolver for dependency and cycle diagnostics.
changes.scope_limit: A dependency may refer to an alias whose own target is directly kept; multi-hop merge declarations are rejected.

test_history.correction_reason: The prior multi-hop PASS expectation contradicted the frozen A02 contract. This revision changes the test to match that contract; the historical v1 evidence is not rewritten.
test_history.count_convention: tests_run counts unittest test methods. The v1 reproduction has 4 failure events across 3 methods because the inaccessible-capability test has keep and merge subtests.
